High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready errata card for [[Het Nkik (PC Errata 2)]] (a fan rendition of its Players Committee errata wording) (A New Hope, Light Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

This is a fan print-ready rendition of the wording documented on [[Het Nkik (PC Errata 2)]], not a scan of that official source image. Its re-typeset text and line wrapping differ, and the gold E is inside the card rather than the official image's white E outside the lower-right frame. These rendition differences are not an additional published PC image version.

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Errata/Light_E/Het Nkik _ E.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1w4VIRY-z6rf0M3aqnKzLJ2cDQXyGxiLx/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Het Nkik _ E.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,340,092 bytes, SHA-256 <code>4ff8aaea99b0959e6ae25360e6cb280e64192d3670a2b586eeaba41bbba89ff7</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 46.0, 47.5, 74.0, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.

The regular face of this card on its article stays [[:File:ANH-L-hetnkik.gif]]; this fan rendition is linked there as a qualified comparison.

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project. Fair use rationale: this is an image of a copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. (card design by the Players Committee). It is used only to identify and study the card on this non-commercial fan wiki, it does not replace any product sold today, and no free equivalent exists.
